description: Let's take up challenges and build solution
summary: AstroCadet: Outpost Command is an interactive space survival simulator designed to train young students as junior astronauts. Players manage power, life support, radiation shielding, and rovers on the Moon and Mars while responding to real space hazards. By turning complex NASA planetary science into hands-on engineering decisions, it inspires the next generation of explorers.
details:
• What it does & How it works: AstroCadet is a 14-Sol strategy simulation where students command either a Lunar South Pole outpost (Shackleton Rim) or a Martian base (Jezero Crater). Every turn, players allocate 10 Power Units across four subsystems—Solar & Battery Grid, ECLSS Life Support & Crops, Radiation & Water-Wall Shield, and Science Rover & Lab—and make critical trade-offs during solar flares, global dust storms, and extreme thermal swings. An in-game AI mentor, Commander Nova, explains the real science behind every outcome. Tools & Tech Used: Built as a zero-dependency web application using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and custom inline SVG graphics for real-time habitat animation
